source.title: Soman, Gandhi, Baskaran M.: Analysis and Design of a Two stage Telescopic OTA using SCL 180nm CMOS Technology (ICNWC 2023)
source.figure: Fig. 2 (p.2) / Fig. 4 (p.5, operating-point schematic): telescopic first stage (M1/M2, cascodes M11/M12 and M9/M10, mirror M3/M4, tail M5) and PMOS common-source second stage M8 with sink M7, CC + RZ Miller compensation
source.inputs: source/ (paper PDF, Paper1_Metrics.xlsx, Paper1_Corners.xlsx, Paper1_Schematic.png; see source/ORIGIN.txt)
modifications: None to final.scs (schemgen export, one uninstantiated subckt read as the DUT body). Sizes follow the Fig. 4 labels, not Table III / Sec. III.B text (three inconsistent size sets in the paper, see known_issues). The paper's bias block (M0, M13-M15 -> VB1/VB2) and the Rz-tracking circuit (M16-M19) are not in the netlist: VB1/VB2 are driven externally and RZ is a fixed-topology resistor.

VB1.provenance: paper: Fig. 4 p.5 operating point (VB1 = 704.872 mV = gates of the PMOS cascodes M9/M10; design step p.3 B.7: Vb1 = 0.7 V); owner Q9a: absolute sizing variable

VB2.provenance: paper: Fig. 4 p.5 operating point (VB2 = 1.15786 V = gates of the NMOS cascodes M11/M12; design step p.3 B.7: Vb2 = 1.2 V); owner Q9a: absolute sizing variable

op_check.note: G8: no exclusions until the reference operating point is inspected (onboarding_status.yaml)

known_issues: The paper gives three mutually inconsistent size sets (Table III with swapped L/W columns; Sec. III.B text W/L ratios; Fig. 4 labels); the netlist follows Fig. 4 (gap analysis).

Ibias is not given; the netlist's IB isource has an undeclared symbol IBIAS_DC. Power 1.4 mW (778 uA at 1.8 V) is inconsistent with ISS + IOSS = 360 uA of the hand design and with Ibias = 11.4 uA through the netlist's mirror ratios (M5/M6 = 7, M7/M6 = 30/0.6 over 1/0.5 = 25); the netlist ratios would need Ibias about 23.6 uA for 1.4 mW.

PSRR 185.33 / 176.69 dB (Table IV) are implausibly high next to DC gain 99 dB and CMRR 129 dB (supply-to-output gain of -86 dB), method not described; likely not reproducible (margin-scored, owner Q5a).
Slew rate is printed 'mV/us' (Table IV) but is 207.6 V/us (Fig. 7 '207.618 MV/s'); read as V/us (owner Q1a).
